_comment: OPTIONAL. Orchestrator session only (the Claude session that ran /set-orchestrator on). Merge ONLY the "hooks" object into that session's settings.json (e.g. $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json) and replace <SKILL_DIR> with the absolute path of the set-orchestrator skill directory. Delete this _comment key when copying. SessionStart (orchestrator-resume-hook.sh): after /compact or a resume, prints a reminder that this session is the orchestrator, with its workers (title, agent, model, handle), its open dispatches and its last Tasks. The matcher is a regex over the SessionStart source. UserPromptSubmit and Stop (orchestrator-ask-hook.sh, no matcher): search the pane's Tasks and commits with the words of the user's prompt, and once more before a question reaches the user, and put the hits in the context; a question costs at most one more turn. All three act only while the Run's state file exists; in every other session they print nothing. You can install the SessionStart entry alone.
